placement.besideType: An extension of {{extendedName}} in the file for {{typeName}}. Extensions of another type belong in that type's own file, such as {{suggestion}}, so everything added to {{extendedName}} is found together.
placement.withoutType: This file is {{fileName}} and extends {{extendedName}}. Name it {{suggestion}} after what it adds, so everything added to {{extendedName}} is found together.

requireMatchingFileName.text: [[declared]] in `{{fileName}}`, and the file is not named for it. [[repairAndWhy]]<<alternative>>.

repairAndWhy.TypeScript: With one component per file, the file name is how a reader finds a component and the component name is how they know what a file holds, and that only works as an index when the two match exactly, case included. Rename the file to `{{componentFileName}}`
repairAndWhy.Swift: Name it `{{typeName}}.swift`, so a reader looking for `{{typeName}}` opens it without a search
